title: Tech Note: 4D for iOS: Push Notifications and Beyond

historical_commentary.text: 4D for iOS, the native mobile-app-generation feature this note extends with push notifications and other advanced capabilities, has since been discontinued, making the entire subject matter obsolete regardless of the specific push-notification mechanism used.
related_updates: 4D for iOS (and 4D for Android) was discontinued in favor of Qodly (a separate low-code app platform) and responsive ORDA/REST-based web apps

Push notifications for a mobile-facing 4D solution today would be implemented via a native/hybrid or PWA shell calling a push service (e.g. APNs/FCM) directly, rather than through the retired 4D for iOS generator
